+# Daily Grind
+
+Static homepage with browser-only encrypted delivery notes. No backend is present;
+notes are not attached to orders or sent to delivery staff.
+
+Install with `npm ci`, run `npm run build` after source changes, and serve the
+repository root over HTTPS (localhost also supports WebCrypto). The checked-in
+`assets/delivery-notes.js` bundle lets the existing static start command work
+without a runtime CDN dependency. Run cryptographic checks with `npm test`.
+
+## Encryption and storage
+
+- Default: the bundled Noble X25519 + ML-KEM-768 hybrid KEM preset. Optional:
+  standalone ML-KEM-768. Both retain post-quantum protection without requiring
+  experimental native browser KEM APIs or silently downgrading to classical crypto.
+- Each save encapsulates a fresh shared secret using only the recipient public
+  key. HKDF-SHA-256 derives a non-extractable AES-256-GCM key with a random salt
+  and a domain-separated context. AES-GCM uses a random 96-bit nonce and 128-bit
+  authentication tag. Version, suite, recipient ID, record ID, and creation time
+  are bound to both key derivation and authenticated associated data.
+- IndexedDB stores the encrypted envelope and recipient public key. The KEM
+  private key is wrapped with AES-GCM under a non-extractable CryptoKey persisted
+  by structured clone. Secret byte buffers are cleared after use where possible;
+  JavaScript cannot guarantee erasure of all engine-managed copies.
+- Reveal decapsulates the secret and authenticates before displaying text via
+  `textContent`. Revealed text hides after 30 seconds or when switching tabs.
+  Delete removes the envelope and all recipient keys. Clearing site data also
+  permanently removes them; there is no recovery or cross-device sync.
+- This protects stored note contents, not against someone using the same browser
+  profile or malicious same-origin JavaScript. There is no customer login here.
+  A real delivery integration needs an authenticated recipient public-key source,
+  a separate courier-side private key, and an authenticated ciphertext API. Do not
+  ship a courier private key to customers or treat this local vault as delivery.
+
+Dependency API reference: https://github.com/paulmillr/noble-post-quantum

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,136 @@
+import { createRecipient, encryptNote, decryptNote, suites } from './notes-crypto.js';
+
+const form = document.querySelector('#delivery-notes-form');
+const input = document.querySelector('#delivery-note');
+const mode = document.querySelector('#note-protection');
+const status = document.querySelector('#note-status');
+const saved = document.querySelector('#saved-note');
+const detail = document.querySelector('#saved-note-detail');
+const reveal = document.querySelector('#reveal-note');
+const remove = document.querySelector('#remove-note');
+const plaintext = document.querySelector('#revealed-note');
+const controls = [...form.querySelectorAll('button, textarea, select'), reveal, remove];
+let db;
+let current;
+let hideTimer;
+
+function setBusy(busy) { controls.forEach(control => { control.disabled = busy; }); }
+function message(text, error = false) {
+  status.textContent = text;
+  status.dataset.error = String(error);
+}
+function hidePlaintext() {
+  clearTimeout(hideTimer);
+  plaintext.textContent = '';
+  plaintext.hidden = true;
+  reveal.textContent = 'Reveal note';
+}
+
+// Resolve on transaction completion, so a success message always means committed storage.
+function transact(action, operation) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const tx = db.transaction('vault', action);
+    let result;
+    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve(result);
+    tx.onabort = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('Storage transaction failed.'));
+    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error || new Error('Storage is unavailable.'));
+    try { operation(tx.objectStore('vault'), value => { result = value; }); }
+    catch (error) { tx.abort(); reject(error); }
+  });
+}
+function read(key) {
+  return transact('readonly', (store, done) => {
+    const request = store.get(key);
+    request.onsuccess = () => done(request.result);
+  });
+}
+function render() {
+  hidePlaintext();
+  saved.hidden = !current;
+  if (current) {
+    detail.textContent = `${suites[current.suite]?.name || 'Unknown protection'} · Saved ${new Date(current.createdAt).toLocaleString()}`;
+  }
+}
+input.addEventListener('input', () => {
+  document.querySelector('#note-count').textContent = `${input.value.length} / 1,000`;
+});
+form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!input.value.trim()) { message('Please enter delivery instructions first.', true); input.focus(); return; }
+  setBusy(true);
+  hidePlaintext();
+  message('Encrypting your note on this device…');
+  try {
+    const recipient = await read(`recipient:${mode.value}`) || await createRecipient(mode.value);
+    const envelope = await encryptNote(input.value, recipient);
+    await transact('readwrite', store => {
+      store.put(recipient, `recipient:${mode.value}`);
+      store.put(envelope, 'note');
+    });
+    current = envelope;
+    input.value = '';
+    document.querySelector('#note-count').textContent = '0 / 1,000';
+    render();
+    message('Encrypted and saved on this device. Your note has not been sent.');
+  } catch {
+    message('Your note could not be saved. Check that browser storage is available and try again.', true);
+  } finally { setBusy(false); }
+});
+reveal.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  if (!plaintext.hidden) { hidePlaintext(); message('Note hidden.'); return; }
+  setBusy(true);
+  message('Authenticating and decrypting your note…');
+  try {
+    const recipient = await read(`recipient:${current.suite}`);
+    if (!recipient) throw new Error('Recipient key is missing.');
+    const text = await decryptNote(current, recipient);
+    // Do not reveal if the user switched away while decryption was pending.
+    if (document.hidden) { message('Note hidden.'); return; }
+    plaintext.textContent = text;
+    plaintext.hidden = false;
+    reveal.textContent = 'Hide note';
+    hideTimer = setTimeout(hidePlaintext, 30_000);
+    message('Note authenticated. It will hide automatically after 30 seconds.');
+  } catch {
+    hidePlaintext();
+    message('Unable to authenticate this note. Its data or encryption key may be missing or changed.', true);
+  } finally { setBusy(false); }
+});
+remove.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+  setBusy(true);
+  hidePlaintext();
+  try {
+    await transact('readwrite', store => store.clear());
+    current = undefined;
+    input.value = '';
+    document.querySelector('#note-count').textContent = '0 / 1,000';
+    render();
+    message('Saved note and its encryption keys deleted from this device.');
+  } catch { message('The note could not be deleted. Please try again.', true); }
+  finally { setBusy(false); }
+});
+document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) hidePlaintext(); });
+window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { hidePlaintext(); input.value = ''; });
+
+async function init() {
+  setBusy(true);
+  if (!window.isSecureContext || !crypto.subtle || !window.indexedDB) {
+    message('Encrypted notes need HTTPS and browser storage. This feature is unavailable here.', true);
+    return;
+  }
+  try {
+    db = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const request = indexedDB.open('daily-grind-encrypted-notes', 1);
+      request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore('vault');
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+      request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error('Close other Daily Grind tabs and try again.'));
+    });
+    db.onversionchange = () => { db.close(); setBusy(true); message('Please reload this page to use encrypted notes.', true); };
+    current = await read('note');
+    render();
+    message(current ? 'Your encrypted note is saved on this device.' : 'Ready to encrypt. Your note stays on this device.');
+    setBusy(false);
+  } catch { message('Browser storage is unavailable. Allow site storage and reload to use encrypted notes.', true); }
+}
+init();

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/notes-crypto.js
@@ -0,0 +1,94 @@
+import { ml_kem768_x25519 } from '@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js';
+import { ml_kem768 } from '@noble/post-quantum/ml-kem.js';
+
+const encoder = new TextEncoder();
+export const suites = {
+  hybrid: { name: 'ML-KEM-768 + X25519', kem: ml_kem768_x25519 },
+  pq: { name: 'ML-KEM-768', kem: ml_kem768 },
+};
+
+function suiteFor(suite) {
+  if (!Object.hasOwn(suites, suite)) throw new Error('Unsupported protection mode.');
+  return suites[suite];
+}
+
+function metadata(envelope) {
+  return encoder.encode(JSON.stringify([
+    'daily-grind-delivery-notes', envelope.version, envelope.suite,
+    envelope.recipientId, envelope.id, envelope.createdAt,
+  ]));
+}
+
+async function deriveKey(secret, salt, context) {
+  const base = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', secret, 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
+  return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
+    { name: 'HKDF', hash: 'SHA-256', salt, info: context }, base,
+    { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt'],
+  );
+}
+
+// Only the public key is used by the sender. Private key bytes are wrapped at rest.
+export async function createRecipient(suite) {
+  const { publicKey, secretKey } = suiteFor(suite).kem.keygen();
+  try {
+    const wrappingKey = await crypto.subtle.generateKey(
+      { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt'],
+    );
+    const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
+    const id = crypto.randomUUID();
+    const wrapped = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
+      { name: 'AES-GCM', iv, additionalData: encoder.encode(`${suite}:${id}`) },
+      wrappingKey, secretKey,
+    );
+    return { suite, id, publicKey, wrappingKey, iv, wrapped };
+  } finally {
+    secretKey.fill(0);
+  }
+}
+
+export async function encryptNote(text, recipient) {
+  if (!text.trim() || text.length > 1000) throw new Error('Enter a note of 1–1,000 characters.');

+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { createRecipient, encryptNote, decryptNote } from '../src/notes-crypto.js';
+
+for (const suite of ['hybrid', 'pq']) {
+  test(`${suite}: persisted recipient decrypts Unicode notes; each save is fresh`, async () => {
+    const recipient = structuredClone(await createRecipient(suite));
+    assert.equal(recipient.wrappingKey.extractable, false);
+    const text = 'Side door 🔑 — 请勿敲门\nLeave quietly.';
+    const first = structuredClone(await encryptNote(text, recipient));
+    const second = await encryptNote(text, recipient);
+    assert.equal(await decryptNote(first, recipient), text);
+    assert.notDeepEqual(first.iv, second.iv);
+    assert.notDeepEqual(first.capsule, second.capsule);
+    assert.notDeepEqual(first.ciphertext, second.ciphertext);
+    assert.equal(JSON.stringify(first).includes(text), false);
+    await assert.rejects(crypto.subtle.exportKey('raw', recipient.wrappingKey));
+  });
+
+  test(`${suite}: rejects ciphertext, capsule, metadata and key tampering`, async () => {
+    const recipient = await createRecipient(suite);
+    const envelope = await encryptNote('Leave at the side door.', recipient);
+    for (const field of ['ciphertext', 'capsule', 'iv', 'salt']) {
+      const changed = structuredClone(envelope);
+      const bytes = new Uint8Array(changed[field]);
+      bytes[0] ^= 1;
+      changed[field] = bytes;
+      await assert.rejects(decryptNote(changed, recipient), field);
+    }
+    for (const field of ['version', 'suite', 'recipientId', 'id', 'createdAt']) {
+      const changed = structuredClone(envelope);
+      changed[field] = 'tampered';
+      await assert.rejects(decryptNote(changed, recipient), field);
+    }
+    const wrongRecipient = await createRecipient(suite);
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(envelope, wrongRecipient));
+    const brokenKey = structuredClone(recipient);
+    new Uint8Array(brokenKey.wrapped)[0] ^= 1;
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(envelope, brokenKey));
+  });
+}
+
+test('rejects unsupported suites and empty or overlong notes', async () => {
+  await assert.rejects(createRecipient('unknown'));
+  const recipient = await createRecipient('hybrid');
+  await assert.rejects(encryptNote('  ', recipient));
+  await assert.rejects(encryptNote('x'.repeat(1001), recipient));
+});

+import { createRecipient, sealNote, openNote, modes } from './crypto.js';

+let notes = [];

+const revealed = new Map();
+
+function report(message, error = false) {
+  status.textContent = message;
+  status.classList.toggle('error', error);
+}
+
+function connect() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = indexedDB.open('daily-grind-private-notes', 1);
+    request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
+      request.result.createObjectStore('notes', { keyPath: 'id' });
+      request.result.createObjectStore('keys', { keyPath: 'keyId' });
+    };
+    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    request.onblocked = () => reject(new Error('Close other Daily Grind tabs and try again.'));
+  });
+}
+
+function allNotes() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const transaction = db.transaction('notes', 'readonly');
+    const request = transaction.objectStore('notes').getAll();
+    transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve(request.result.sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt)));
+    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
+  });
+}
+
+function getKey(keyId) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = db.transaction('keys', 'readonly').objectStore('keys').get(keyId);
+    request.onsuccess = () => request.result ? resolve(request.result) : reject(new Error('The recovery key is missing from this browser.'));
+    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+  });
+}
+
+function persist(envelope, recipient) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const transaction = db.transaction(['notes', 'keys'], 'readwrite');
+    transaction.objectStore('keys').put(recipient);
+    transaction.objectStore('notes').put(envelope);
+    transaction.oncomplete = resolve;
+    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
+    transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error('Saving was interrupted.'));
+  });
+}
+
+function removeNote(envelope) {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const transaction = db.transaction(['notes', 'keys'], 'readwrite');
+    transaction.objectStore('notes').delete(envelope.id);
+    transaction.objectStore('keys').delete(envelope.keyId);
+    transaction.oncomplete = resolve;
+    transaction.onerror = () => reject(transaction.error);
+    transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error || new Error('Removing the note was interrupted.'));
+  });
+}
+
+function switchTab(saved) {

+      report('This suggestion would exceed the 1,000 character limit.', true);

+    noteInput.focus();

+});

+});
+
+$('#compose-panel').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => {
+  event.preventDefault();

+    noteInput.setCustomValidity('Please add your delivery instructions.');
+    noteInput.reportValidity();
+    return;
+  }
+  busy = true;
+  const button = $('#save-button');
+  button.disabled = true;
+  noteInput.readOnly = true;

+    busy = false;
+  }

+import { ml_kem768_x25519 } from '@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js';

+export const modes = Object.freeze({
+  classical: { name: 'Classic', algorithm: 'X25519' },
+  hybrid: { name: 'Hybrid', algorithm: 'X-Wing (X25519 + ML-KEM-768)' },
+  quantum: { name: 'Post-quantum', algorithm: 'ML-KEM-768' },

+const b64 = (value) => btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes(value)));
+const unb64 = (value) => Uint8Array.from(atob(value), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0));

+function checkMode(mode) {
+  if (!Object.hasOwn(modes, mode)) throw new Error('Unsupported protection mode.');

+export async function createRecipient(mode) {

+  const keyId = b64(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', keys.publicKey));

+    mode: envelope.mode,
+    keyId: envelope.keyId,
+    createdAt: envelope.createdAt,
+    cipher: envelope.cipher,
+    kdf: envelope.kdf,
+    encapsulation: envelope.encapsulation,
+    salt: envelope.salt,
+    nonce: envelope.nonce,
+  }));

+  checkMode(recipient.mode);

+    throw new Error('Please enter a note between 1 and 1,000 characters.');
+  }
+  let secret;
+  let encapsulation;
+  let plaintext;
+  try {
+    if (recipient.mode === 'classical') {
+      const ephemeral = x25519.keygen();
+      try {
+        secret = x25519.getSharedSecret(ephemeral.secretKey, recipient.publicKey);

+      } finally { ephemeral.secretKey.fill(0); }
+    } else {
+      const result = kem(recipient.mode).encapsulate(recipient.publicKey);
+      secret = result.sharedSecret;
+      encapsulation = result.cipherText;
+    }

+    const nonce = random(12);

+      version: 1, id: crypto.randomUUID(), mode: recipient.mode,
+      keyId: recipient.keyId, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),

+      encapsulation: b64(encapsulation), salt: b64(salt), nonce: b64(nonce),
+    };

+      name: 'AES-GCM', iv: nonce, additionalData: header(envelope), tagLength: 128,
+    }, key, plaintext));

+  } finally {
+    secret?.fill(0);
+    plaintext?.fill(0);
+  }

+
+export async function openNote(envelope, recipient) {
+  checkMode(envelope.mode);
+  if (envelope.version !== 1 || envelope.cipher !== 'AES-256-GCM' || envelope.kdf !== 'HKDF-SHA-256' ||
+      envelope.mode !== recipient.mode || envelope.keyId !== recipient.keyId) {
+    throw new Error('The note’s protection details do not match its recovery key.');
+  }
+  let secret;
+  let plaintext;
+  try {
+    const encapsulation = unb64(envelope.encapsulation);
+    secret = envelope.mode === 'classical'
+      ? x25519.getSharedSecret(recipient.secretKey, encapsulation)
+      : kem(envelope.mode).decapsulate(encapsulation, recipient.secretKey);
+    const nonce = unb64(envelope.nonce);
+    const salt = unb64(envelope.salt);
+    if (nonce.length !== 12 || salt.length !== 32) throw new Error('Invalid encryption parameters.');
+    const key = await deriveKey(secret, salt, envelope.mode, envelope.keyId);
+    plaintext = bytes(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({
+      name: 'AES-GCM', iv: nonce, additionalData: header(envelope), tagLength: 128,
+    }, key, unb64(envelope.ciphertext)));
+    return decoder.decode(plaintext);
+  } finally {
+    secret?.fill(0);
+    plaintext?.fill(0);
+  }

+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { createRecipient, sealNote, openNote } from '../src/crypto.js';
+
+for (const mode of ['classical', 'hybrid', 'quantum']) {
+  test(`${mode}: encrypts Unicode notes, authenticates envelopes, and uses fresh randomness`, async () => {
+    const recipient = await createRecipient(mode);
+    const plaintext = 'Gate code: 2486. Leave at the café door. ☕\nDo not ring.';
+    const envelope = await sealNote(plaintext, recipient);
+    assert.equal(await openNote(envelope, recipient), plaintext);
+    assert.ok(!JSON.stringify(envelope).includes('2486'));
+    assert.ok(!Object.hasOwn(envelope, 'secretKey'));
+    const second = await sealNote(plaintext, recipient);
+    assert.notEqual(second.nonce, envelope.nonce);
+    assert.notEqual(second.salt, envelope.salt);
+    assert.notEqual(second.encapsulation, envelope.encapsulation);
+    assert.notEqual(second.ciphertext, envelope.ciphertext);
+    for (const field of ['ciphertext', 'encapsulation', 'salt', 'nonce']) {
+      const changed = Buffer.from(envelope[field], 'base64');
+      changed[0] ^= 1;
+      await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, [field]: changed.toString('base64') }, recipient));
+    }
+    for (const field of ['id', 'createdAt', 'keyId', 'mode', 'cipher', 'kdf', 'version']) {
+      await assert.rejects(openNote({ ...envelope, [field]: field === 'version' ? 2 : 'changed' }, recipient));
+    }
+    const otherRecipient = await createRecipient(mode);
+    await assert.rejects(openNote(envelope, { ...otherRecipient, keyId: recipient.keyId }));
+    recipient.secretKey.fill(0);
+    otherRecipient.secretKey.fill(0);
+  });
+}
+
+test('invalid modes and empty or oversized notes are rejected', async () => {
+  await assert.rejects(createRecipient('unknown'));
+  await assert.rejects(createRecipient('__proto__'));
+  const recipient = await createRecipient('hybrid');
+  await assert.rejects(sealNote('   ', recipient));
+  await assert.rejects(sealNote('x'.repeat(1001), recipient));
+  const note = 'x'.repeat(1000);
+  assert.equal(await openNote(await sealNote(note, recipient), recipient), note);
+  recipient.secretKey.fill(0);
+});

+# Rewards registration integration
+
+This repository is a static site. The registration UI is implemented, but it does
+not create accounts until a backend implements the same-origin endpoints below.
+It never simulates successful registration. Personal data stays in the current
+form and is not written to browser storage or analytics.
+
+## API contract
+
+- `GET /api/rewards/csrf`: return `200 application/json` with
+  `{ "token": "<cryptographically random, session-bound token of 32–512 characters>" }`.
+  Use `Cache-Control: no-store` and a `Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` session cookie.
+- `POST /api/rewards/register`: accept multipart form data and require the
+  `X-CSRF-Token` header. Fields: `full_name`, `email`, `password`,
+  `coffee_preference` (`hot`, `iced`, or `both`), optional
+  `marketing_opt_in=yes`, and required `terms_accepted=yes`.
+- Return a successful JSON response with `{ "status": "verification_required" }`
+  only after the registration request has been processed and a verification email
+  queued. Return generic responses for existing emails to avoid account enumeration.
+  The UI deliberately requires both JSON and this status, so a static host's HTML
+  fallback cannot be mistaken for success.
+- Return `429` when rate limited; other non-success responses show a retry message.
+  No arbitrary server error text is inserted into the page.
+
+## Server requirements before release
+
+Validate the CSRF token and exact request Origin against the session; disallow
+cross-origin access. Enforce HTTPS, request size limits, rate limits, and server-side
+validation of every field (including Unicode name support, email length/format,
+15–128 character passwords, preference allowlist, and explicit terms acceptance).
+Never trust client validation. Preserve password bytes rather than trimming them.
+Hash passwords using a maintained password-hashing implementation such as Argon2id,
+check against compromised passwords, and never log credentials or tokens. Require
+email verification before activating rewards. Persist marketing consent separately
+and only when explicitly checked. Use parameterized database writes and avoid
+storing unverified accounts indefinitely.
+
+Configure registration POST handling to deduplicate retries and verify that
+`/rewards/terms` and `/privacy-policy` contain the actual program policies before
+launch. Apply a deployment Content Security Policy compatible with the existing
+site styles; the registration script and stylesheet are external files and use no
+inline event handlers. Without JavaScript, the UI explains that secure registration
+requires JavaScript and leaves controls disabled, preventing an unprotected POST.
+
+## Checks
+
+Run `node --check assets/rewards.js` for syntax validation. There is no build script
+or backend in this project. Do not start the static server to run this check.

+# Rewards registration integration
+
+The static page implements the three-step registration UI. No registration service,
+database, or email delivery service is present in this repository. The page does not
+claim registration succeeded when the API is missing. Do not enable real enrollment
+until the endpoints and linked Rewards Terms and Privacy Policy are available.
+
+## Same-origin API contract
+
+- `GET /api/rewards/csrf`: return JSON `{ "token": "<session-bound random token>" }`.
+  Use at least 32 bytes of cryptographic randomness. Issue a `Secure`, `HttpOnly`,
+  `SameSite=Lax` session cookie. Return `Cache-Control: no-store`.
+- `POST /api/rewards/register`: accept only JSON with `givenName` (required, trimmed,
+  1–100 characters), `familyName` (optional, at most 100 characters), `email`
+  (required, valid, at most 254 characters), `favoriteDrink` (empty, `espresso`,
+  `latte`, `filter`, `cold-brew`, or `other`), and the booleans `marketing` and
+  `termsAccepted`. Require `termsAccepted: true`; marketing defaults to false.
+  Reject unknown fields and excessive body sizes. Validate everything on the server.
+- Before processing, require HTTPS, check the exact configured `Origin`, content
+  type, session, and constant-time CSRF token comparison. Do not allow cross-origin
+  credentialed access. Reject invalid CSRF/session with 403.
+- Honor `Idempotency-Key` for retries, scope it to the session and canonical request
+  body, and return the same result for repeated requests. Reject key reuse for a
+  different body. Apply server-side rate limits to token requests, registration,
+  and email sends; return 429 when exceeded.
+- Return HTTP 202 and `{ "status": "verification_pending" }` only after securely
+  accepting a request. Give the same response for existing addresses to avoid
+  account enumeration. Use 422 for invalid payloads and 5xx for unavailable services.
+  Responses must be JSON with `Cache-Control: no-store` and must not echo PII.
+- Send a single-use, expiring verification link through a configured email provider;
+  store a hash of the token and activate membership only after verification.
+  Use parameterized database queries and enforce unique normalized email addresses.
+  Record the applicable terms version and consent timestamp server-side. Keep
+  marketing consent separate from membership. Never log request bodies or tokens.
+- Configure HTTPS, HSTS, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, an appropriate CSP, and a
+  restrictive referrer policy on the host. The current page uses inline CSS; allow
+  it with a style hash or extract the stylesheet before enforcing a strict CSP.
+
+The client keeps entered details in memory only, sends no PII in URLs, uses text
+rendering for review values, prevents duplicate clicks, times out stalled requests,
+and retains values after recoverable errors. Client checks improve usability;
+server checks are the security boundary. No password is collected.
+
+## Local checks
+
+This buildless site has no build script or dependencies. Run `node --check rewards.js`
+for JavaScript syntax validation. Do not use a development server as a build check.

+# The Daily Grind
+
+The homepage includes field INP instrumentation using the attribution build of
+[Google's web-vitals](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/web-vitals). The module is
+self-hosted and deferred; it does not change the visible homepage.
+
+## Build and checks
+
+Run `npm ci`, then `npm run build` after changing `src/` or updating dependencies.
+Commit the generated `assets/inp.js` and retain `assets/web-vitals-LICENSE.txt` so the existing static
+hosting setup can serve the instrumentation without running a build at startup.
+Run `npm test` for payload and delivery checks using synthetic events, without a
+browser or server.
+
+## Connect field collection
+
+The `inp-endpoint` meta tag in `index.html` defaults to `/analytics/inp`.
+**This repository has no backend. Production hosting must route that URL to a
+real analytics collector accepting JSON POST requests**, or change the meta tag
+to an existing collector. Static hosting alone will not store these reports.
+Return a successful status such as 204. For a cross-origin collector, configure
+CORS for JSON POSTs and allow its origin in the site's `connect-src` CSP.
+
+Store/upsert reports by `id` (and `name`): a visit can emit an updated INP after
+being hidden and resumed. Use its latest absolute `value`, not the sum of updates.
+Back/forward cache restorations receive new metric IDs. Aggregate the latest
+visit values at the 75th percentile, optionally segmented by interaction target
+and navigation type. Good INP is at most 200 ms; values over 500 ms are poor.
+Reports include good interactions as well as slow ones so the distribution is
+not biased toward slow visits. No-interaction visits and browsers without Event
+Timing do not report INP; absence is not a score of zero.
+
+## Diagnose slow interactions
+
+- `inputDelay`, `processingDuration`, and `presentationDelay` split the latency
+  into queued work before handlers, event handling, and waiting for the next paint.
+- `interactionTarget` uses stable `data-inp-target` labels for homepage links,
+  with a tag-name fallback. No input values, link text, or raw DOM is transmitted.
+- `longestScript` identifies the largest overlapping script with its bundle URL,
+  function name, character position, invoker type, overlapping duration, and INP
+  subpart. URLs omit credentials, queries, and fragments. Use the matching deployed
+  bundle and source map to resolve minified locations. This identifies observed
+  blocking work; it is not a complete causal JavaScript stack trace.
+- `forcedStyleDuration` and `forcedLayoutDuration` distinguish synchronous work
+  inside that script. Older implementations retain `forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration`.
+- `rendering.frameStyleDuration` and `frameLayoutDuration` sum separate style and
+  layout work across the overlapping Long Animation Frames. These are whole-frame
+  totals and can include work outside the interaction window.
+- `rendering.totalStyleAndLayoutDuration` is the library's interaction-clipped
+  combined fallback, including forced style/layout work. `totalScriptDuration`,
+  `totalPaintDuration`, and `totalUnattributedDuration` provide the remaining
+  library breakdown. Do not add the whole-frame or forced timings to these totals:
+  they overlap. Paint timing is an estimate, not a compositor/GPU trace.
+
+Unsupported optional timings are `null`, not zero. LoAF is optional: browsers can
+still report INP phases without script/rendering attribution. Even supported
+browsers may have no overlapping long frame or attributable script.
+
+The collector queues the latest candidate using `fetchLater()` where available.
+Its fallback sends when the page becomes hidden or receives `pagehide`, using
+`sendBeacon()` then `fetch(..., {keepalive: true})` if necessary. Native scheduling
+quota failures also use this fallback. No unload handler, polling, or self-profiling
+is installed. Delivery is best effort; browser shutdown, network failures, and
+blocking policies can prevent collection.

+# The Daily Grind
+
+Static homepage with self-hosted `web-vitals` INP attribution. No server or build
+is needed to serve the checked-in homepage and `assets/` files.
+
+## Field INP collection
+
+The module in `assets/inp.mjs` registers `onINP` once. The library handles page
+visibility changes and back/forward cache restores. It reports page INP, not every
+interaction. Visits without eligible interactions do not produce an INP value.
+
+Every report includes the metric ID, value, delta, rating, navigation type, a
+stable interaction label, load state, and input delay / event processing /
+presentation delay in milliseconds. Values above 200 ms also include overlapping
+Long Animation Frame scripts, source URLs/functions/character positions, forced
+layout costs, frame rendering timestamps, the longest script's INP phase, and
+library totals for scripts, style/layout, paint and unattributed time.
+
+**Deployment integration required for persistent collection:** this static repo
+has no backend or analytics account. Set the `inp-report-endpoint` meta tag in
+`index.html` to your deployed same-origin collector path (for example `/rum`).
+The collector must accept JSON POSTs. Reports use `sendBeacon`, with keepalive
+`fetch` as a fallback; no requests go to an invented endpoint by default.
+
+Alternatively, connect an existing analytics SDK to the `daily-grind:inp` window
+event; its `detail` is a plain JSON-safe report. `window.dailyGrindINP` holds only
+the latest report for integration diagnostics. These local hooks alone do not
+persist field data. Example adapter, registered before the monitoring module:
+
+```js
+window.addEventListener('daily-grind:inp', ({ detail }) => {
+  // Pass detail to your analytics SDK here.
+});
+```
+
+Upsert reports by metric `id`, keeping the most recently received value rather
+than counting repeated visibility reports as separate visits. BFCache restores
+receive new IDs. Compute p75 over visit values, including good visits; group slow
+visits by interaction label, script source/function and dominant INP phase.
+
+## Attribution limits
+
+Long Animation Frames are browser dependent and only expose long frames and
+eligible script execution. Unsupported or missing data is reported as null/empty,
+not zero work. Attribution indicates overlapping work, not proof of causality.
+Paint totals describe the library's estimated presentation interval; they do not
+separate GPU, raster and compositor work. Raw frame durations can extend outside
+the INP interval and must not be summed as INP costs. Script overlap durations are
+clipped to the interaction window. Payloads retain at most ten scripts (ranked by
+overlap) and five frames, with truncation flags and untruncated library totals.
+
+No input values, text content, raw DOM selectors, or page query/hash are collected.
+Script URLs have their query/hash removed. Stable `data-inp-target` labels identify
+homepage links; other elements use their tag name.
+
+## Maintenance and checks
+
+`npm ci` installs the pinned dependency. `npm run build` refreshes the committed
+self-hosted attribution bundle and its license from that dependency. Deploy those
+assets with `index.html`. `npm test` runs Node-only serialization and transport
+tests, without a browser or a running server.
+
+References: [web-vitals](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/web-vitals),
+[INP attribution guidance](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/modern-web-guidance/guides/performance/identify-inp-causes).

diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 4479b53..fb3bb48 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -15,3 +15,52 @@ The application will now be running on `http://localhost:11224`.
 - **[React](https://react.dev/)**: Used for UI components.
 - **[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/)**: For styling the application.
 - **[Astro DB](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/database/)**: Powers the comments feature, using a libSQL-compatible database.
+
+## Account settings and passkey management
+
+Account settings are at `/devtools-times/account` (linked in the header). Sign-in now
+uses a same-origin endpoint and retains the identity service's token in Astro's
+server-side session, never in localStorage or a browser-readable cookie.
+
+Set the server environment variable `ACCOUNT_API_URL` to an identity backend's API
+base URL, including any path prefix. It defaults to the existing remote identity
+service. That service must implement the following contract; its current public
+credential endpoints return 404, which the UI reports as unavailable rather than
+substituting demo credentials:
+
+- `POST login`, JSON `{ username, password }`, returns `{ token }` for a verified login.
+- `GET credentials`, authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, returns
+  `{ rpId, userId, credentials: [{ id, name, aaguid?, registeredAt, lastUsedAt? }] }`.
+  This must be the **complete** list for the authenticated user, including keys
+  registered on other devices. IDs and `userId` are unpadded Base64URL; `rpId` must
+  match registration. Timestamps are epoch milliseconds; `lastUsedAt` may be null.
+- `PUT credential/:id`, JSON `{ name }`, persists the credential nickname.
+- `DELETE credential/:id` revokes that credential for future authentication.
+  Both mutation endpoints must enforce ownership from the bearer token, not from
+  a supplied user ID, and return a 2xx response only after persistence. Expired
+  tokens return 401. Credential names must be 1–80 characters after trimming.
+
+The local API checks session authentication, mutation origin, input, and ownership.
+The upstream identity service remains the source of truth for registered credentials;
+this app does not invent credentials or implement a second authentication database.
+Deploy with HTTPS and durable shared Astro session storage for multiple instances
+(the Node adapter defaults to local filesystem storage).
+
+The panel signals the complete accepted credential list on load and after deletion,
+including an empty list after the final key is removed. It uses the server's RP ID
+and user handle. Unsupported or failed browser synchronization does not undo server
+changes; the UI explains how to update a password manager manually. Credential
+nicknames are account labels, not user profile names, and do not call
+`signalCurrentUserDetails`.
+
+Provider metadata and deduplicated PNG icons are a local snapshot of the
+[passkey-authenticator-aaguids registry](https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids),
+retrieved November 8, 2026. Unknown or zero AAGUIDs use a generic key icon; provider
+metadata is presentation only and never influences authorization.
+
+Automated checks (no running application server required):
+
+```sh
+node --test tests/passkeys.test.mjs
+pnpm run build
+```

+import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
+import { KeyIcon, ShieldCheckIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline';
+import { isPasskeyList, syncPasskeys, type PasskeyList } from '../lib/passkeys';
+import providers from '../lib/passkey-providers.json';
+
+const apiUrl = `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}api/account/passkeys`;
+const button = 'rounded border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-semibold hover:bg-gray-100 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-gray-900 disabled:opacity-50';
+
+async function request(url: string, init?: RequestInit) {
+  const response = await fetch(url, { ...init, cache: 'no-store', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
+  const data = await response.json();
+  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(response.status === 401 ? 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.' : data.error || 'Something went wrong. Please try again.');
+  return data;
+}
+
+function date(timestamp: number | null | undefined) {
+  if (timestamp == null) return 'Not used yet';
+  const value = new Date(timestamp);
+  return Number.isNaN(value.getTime()) ? 'Unknown' : value.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
+}
+
+export default function PasskeySettings() {
+  const [list, setList] = useState<PasskeyList | null>(null);
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
+  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
+  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<string | null>(null);
+  const [name, setName] = useState('');
+  const [error, setError] = useState('');
+  const [message, setMessage] = useState('');
+  const [sync, setSync] = useState('');
+  const listHeading = useRef<HTMLHeadingElement>(null);
+
+  async function load() {
+    const data = await request(apiUrl);
+    if (!isPasskeyList(data)) throw new Error('Unable to load a complete passkey list. Please try again.');
+    setList(data);
+    const result = await syncPasskeys(data, typeof window.PublicKeyCredential === 'undefined' ? undefined : window.PublicKeyCredential);
+    setSync(result === 'synced' ? 'Your browser has been notified of your current passkeys.' : result === 'unsupported'
+      ? 'This browser cannot sync passkey changes automatically. You can still manage your passkeys here; remove unused entries from your password manager too.'
+      : 'Your account is up to date, but browser sync did not complete. Refresh to retry, or update your password manager manually.');
+  }
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let active = true;
+    // Avoid a stale mount signaling credentials after this panel has been left.
+    (async () => {
+      try {
+        const data = await request(apiUrl);
+        if (!active) return;
+        if (!isPasskeyList(data)) throw new Error('Unable to load a complete passkey list. Please try again.');
+        setList(data);
+        const result = await syncPasskeys(data, typeof window.PublicKeyCredential === 'undefined' ? undefined : window.PublicKeyCredential);
+        if (active) setSync(result === 'synced' ? 'Your browser has been notified of your current passkeys.' : result === 'unsupported'
+          ? 'Automatic browser sync is unavailable. Remove unused passkeys from your password manager too.'
+          : 'Browser sync could not complete. Refresh to retry, or update your password manager manually.');
+      } catch (err) { if (active) setError((err as Error).message); }
+      finally { if (active) setLoading(false); }
+    })();
+    return () => { active = false; };
+  }, []);
+
+  async function refresh() {
+    setLoading(true); setError(''); setMessage('');
+    try { await load(); } catch (err) { setError((err as Error).message); }
+    finally { setLoading(false); }
+  }
+
+  async function change(id: string, method: 'PUT' | 'DELETE') {
+    if (busy) return;
+    setBusy(true); setError(''); setMessage('');
+    let saved = false;
+    try {
+      await request(`${apiUrl}/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method, ...(method === 'PUT' ? { body: JSON.stringify({ name: name.trim() }) } : {}) });
+      saved = true;
+      setEditing(null); setRemoving(null);
+      // Re-fetch the authoritative complete list, rather than signaling a locally filtered stale list.
+      if (method === 'DELETE') {
+        setList(null); setSync('');
+        await load();
+      } else {
+        setList(previous => previous && ({ ...previous, credentials: previous.credentials.map(key => key.id === id ? { ...key, name: name.trim() } : key) }));
+      }
+      setMessage(method === 'PUT' ? 'Passkey display name updated.' : 'Passkey removed from your account.');
+      listHeading.current?.focus();
+    } catch (err) {
+      setError(saved ? 'Your passkey was updated, but the list could not be refreshed. Refresh to load your current passkeys and sync your browser.' : (err as Error).message);
+    } finally { setBusy(false); }
+  }
+
+  return <section aria-labelledby="passkeys-heading" className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg bg-white">
+    <div className="p-6 border-b border-gray-200 flex items-start gap-4">

+      <div className="flex-1">
+        <h2 id="passkeys-heading" ref={listHeading} tabIndex={-1} className="text-xl font-bold">Passkeys</h2>
+        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-600">Manage the passkeys you use to sign in to The DevTools Times. Give each one a recognizable name and remove any you no longer use.</p>
+      </div>
+    </div>
+    <div className="p-6">
+      <div role="status" className="text-sm text-green-800">{message}</div>
+      {error && <p role="alert" className="mb-4 rounded bg-red-50 p-3 text-sm text-red-800">{error} <a href={`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}signin`} className="underline">Sign in</a></p>}
+      {loading && <p role="status" className="text-sm text-gray-600">Loading your passkeys…</p>}
+      {!loading && list && <>
+        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-500 mb-4">{list.credentials.length} registered {list.credentials.length === 1 ? 'passkey' : 'passkeys'}</p>
+        {list.credentials.length === 0 ? <div className="py-8 text-center text-gray-600"><KeyIcon className="w-8 h-8 mx-auto mb-3" aria-hidden="true" /><p className="font-semibold text-gray-900">No registered passkeys</p><p className="text-sm mt-2">Passkeys registered to your account will appear here.</p></div> :
+          <ul className="divide-y divide-gray-200">{list.credentials.map(key => {
+            const provider = key.aaguid && key.aaguid !== '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ? (providers as Record<string, { name: string; icon_light?: string }>)[key.aaguid.toLowerCase()] : undefined;
+            const title = key.name || provider?.name || 'Unnamed passkey';
+            return <li key={key.id} className="py-5 first:pt-0 last:pb-0">
+              <div className="flex gap-3 items-start">
+                <div className="p-2 bg-gray-50 rounded border border-gray-200 shrink-0">{provider?.icon_light ? <img src={`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}${provider.icon_light}`} alt="" className="w-6 h-6" /> : <KeyIcon className="w-6 h-6 text-gray-600" aria-hidden="true" />}</div>
+                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
+                  <h3 className="font-semibold break-words">{title}</h3>
+                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-600">{provider?.name || 'Unknown passkey provider'}</p>
+                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">Registered {date(key.registeredAt)} <span aria-hidden="true">·</span> Last used: {date(key.lastUsedAt)}</p>
+                </div>
+              </div>
+              {editing === key.id ? <form className="mt-4" onSubmit={event => { event.preventDefault(); void change(key.id, 'PUT'); }}>
+                <label htmlFor={`name-${key.id}`} className="block text-sm font-medium mb-2">Passkey display name</label>
+                <input id={`name-${key.id}`} value={name} onChange={event => setName(event.target.value)} autoFocus required maxLength={80} disabled={busy} className="w-full rounded border border-gray-400 p-2 text-sm" />
+                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-2">This label is saved to your account. It does not rename the entry in your password manager.</p>
+                <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3"><button className={button} disabled={busy || !name.trim()}>{busy ? 'Saving…' : 'Save name'}</button><button type="button" className={button} disabled={busy} onClick={() => setEditing(null)}>Cancel</button></div>
+              </form> : removing === key.id ? <div className="mt-4 rounded border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4">
+                <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Remove “{title}”?</p>
+                <p className="text-sm text-gray-700 mt-2">You will no longer be able to sign in with this passkey. Make sure you can use your password or another passkey{list.credentials.length === 1 ? '—this is your last registered passkey' : ''}.</p>
+                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mt-3"><button autoFocus className={button} disabled={busy} onClick={() => setRemoving(null)}>Keep passkey</button><button className={`${button} text-red-800 border-red-300`} disabled={busy} onClick={() => void change(key.id, 'DELETE')}>{busy ? 'Removing…' : 'Remove passkey'}</button></div>
+              </div> : <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4"><button className={button} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Rename ${title}`} onClick={() => { setEditing(key.id); setRemoving(null); setName(title); }}>Rename</button><button className={`${button} text-red-700`} disabled={busy} aria-label={`Remove ${title}`} onClick={() => { setRemoving(key.id); setEditing(null); }}>Remove</button></div>}
+            </li>;
+          })}</ul>}
+        <p className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-gray-200 text-xs text-gray-500" role="status">{sync}</p>
+      </>}
+      <button className={`${button} mt-5`} disabled={busy || loading} onClick={() => void refresh()}>Refresh passkeys</button>
+    </div>
+  </section>;
+}

+++ b/src/lib/account-server.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import type { APIContext } from 'astro';
+
+export interface AccountSession { token: string; username: string }
+
+export function json(data: unknown, status = 200) {
+  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
+    status,
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' },
+  });
+}
+
+export function sameOrigin(request: Request) {
+  return request.headers.get('Origin') === new URL(request.url).origin;
+}
+
+export async function getAccount(session: APIContext['session']): Promise<AccountSession | undefined> {
+  return await session?.get('account') as AccountSession | undefined;
+}
+
+// This is the same identity service used for registration; credentials remain authoritative there.
+export async function accountFetch(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}, token?: string) {
+  const base = process.env.ACCOUNT_API_URL || 'https://us-central1-web-devrel-apps.cloudfunctions.net/times_cdn/api/';
+  return fetch(new URL(path, base.endsWith('/') ? base : `${base}/`), {
+    ...init,
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}) },
+    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15_000),
+    redirect: 'error',
+  });
+}
+
+export async function requireAccount(context: APIContext) {
+  const account = await getAccount(context.session);
+  if (!account) return json({ error: 'Please sign in to manage your passkeys.' }, 401);
+  if (context.request.method !== 'GET' && !sameOrigin(context.request)) {
+    return json({ error: 'This request must come from your account settings.' }, 403);
+  }
+  return account;
+}
+
+export async function upstreamError(response: Response, context: APIContext) {
+  if (response.status === 401 || response.status === 403) {
+    await context.session?.delete('account');
+    return json({ error: 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.' }, 401);
+  }
+  return json({ error: response.status === 404
+    ? 'Passkey management is currently unavailable. Please try again later.'
+    : 'We could not update your passkeys. Please try again.' }, 502);
+}

diff --git a/src/lib/passkeys.ts b/src/lib/passkeys.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..00793e2
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/lib/passkeys.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+export interface Passkey {
+  id: string;
+  name: string;
+  aaguid?: string;
+  registeredAt: number;
+  lastUsedAt?: number | null;
+}
+
+export interface PasskeyList {
+  rpId: string;
+  userId: string;
+  credentials: Passkey[];
+}
+
+export function isBase64Url(value: unknown): value is string {
+  return typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0 && value.length % 4 !== 1 && /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value);
+}
+
+// Reject incomplete or malformed lists: signaling a partial list can hide valid passkeys.
+export function isPasskeyList(value: unknown): value is PasskeyList {
+  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return false;
+  const list = value as PasskeyList;
+  return typeof list.rpId === 'string' && /^[a-z0-9.-]+$/i.test(list.rpId) &&
+    isBase64Url(list.userId) && Array.isArray(list.credentials) &&
+    list.credentials.every(key => key && isBase64Url(key.id) && typeof key.name === 'string' &&
+      (key.aaguid === undefined || typeof key.aaguid === 'string') &&
+      Number.isFinite(key.registeredAt) && (key.lastUsedAt == null || Number.isFinite(key.lastUsedAt)));
+}
+
+type SignalAPI = {
+  signalAllAcceptedCredentials?: (options: { rpId: string; userId: string; allAcceptedCredentialIds: string[] }) => Promise<void>;
+};
+
+export async function syncPasskeys(list: PasskeyList, api?: SignalAPI): Promise<'synced' | 'unsupported' | 'failed'> {
+  if (!api?.signalAllAcceptedCredentials) return 'unsupported';
+  if (!isPasskeyList(list)) {
+    console.warn('Passkey synchronization skipped: invalid server credential list.');
+    return 'failed';
+  }
+  try {
+    await api.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({
+      rpId: list.rpId,
+      userId: list.userId,
+      allAcceptedCredentialIds: list.credentials.map(key => key.id),
+    });
+    return 'synced';
+  } catch (error) {
+    console.warn('Passkey synchronization could not complete.', error);
+    return 'failed';
+  }
+}

+import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
+import { accountFetch, json, sameOrigin } from '../../../lib/account-server.ts';
+
+export const POST: APIRoute = async ({ request, session }) => {
+  if (!sameOrigin(request)) return json({ error: 'Invalid request origin.' }, 403);
+  if (!session) return json({ error: 'Account sessions are unavailable.' }, 503);
+  try {
+    const { username, password } = await request.json();
+    if (typeof username !== 'string' || !username.trim() || typeof password !== 'string' || !password) {
+      return json({ error: 'Enter your username and password.' }, 400);
+    }
+    const response = await accountFetch('login', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }) });
+    if (!response.ok) return json({ error: response.status === 401 ? 'Incorrect username or password.' : 'Sign in is unavailable. Please try again.' }, response.status === 401 ? 401 : 502);
+    const data = await response.json();
+    if (typeof data.token !== 'string' || !data.token) return json({ error: 'The sign-in service did not provide an account session.' }, 502);
+    await session.regenerate();
+    await session.set('account', { token: data.token, username: username.trim() });
+    return json({ success: true });
+  } catch {
+    return json({ error: 'Unable to sign in. Please try again.' }, 502);
+  }
+};

+import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
+import { accountFetch, json, requireAccount, upstreamError } from '../../../../lib/account-server.ts';
+import { isBase64Url, isPasskeyList } from '../../../../lib/passkeys.ts';
+
+const mutate: APIRoute = async context => {
+  const account = await requireAccount(context);
+  if (account instanceof Response) return account;
+  const id = context.params.id;
+  if (!isBase64Url(id)) return json({ error: 'Invalid passkey.' }, 400);
+  try {
+    let body: string | undefined;
+    if (context.request.method === 'PUT') {
+      let input;
+      try { input = await context.request.json(); } catch { return json({ error: 'Enter a display name.' }, 400); }
+      const name = typeof input?.name === 'string' ? input.name.trim() : '';
+      if (!name || name.length > 80) return json({ error: 'Use a display name between 1 and 80 characters.' }, 400);
+      body = JSON.stringify({ name });
+    }
+    // Check ownership using the authenticated user's complete list before forwarding any mutation.
+    const listResponse = await accountFetch('credentials', {}, account.token);
+    if (!listResponse.ok) return upstreamError(listResponse, context);
+    const list = await listResponse.json();
+    if (!isPasskeyList(list)) return json({ error: 'Unable to verify your registered passkeys.' }, 502);
+    if (!list.credentials.some(key => key.id === id)) return json({ error: 'This passkey was not found in your account. Refresh your passkeys.' }, 404);
+    const response = await accountFetch(`credential/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: context.request.method, body }, account.token);
+    if (!response.ok) return upstreamError(response, context);
+    return json({ success: true });
+  } catch {
+    return json({ error: 'Unable to update your passkey. Please try again.' }, 502);
+  }
+};
+export const PUT = mutate;
+export const DELETE = mutate;

+import type { APIRoute } from 'astro';
+import { accountFetch, json, requireAccount, upstreamError } from '../../../../lib/account-server.ts';
+import { isPasskeyList } from '../../../../lib/passkeys.ts';
+
+export const GET: APIRoute = async context => {
+  const account = await requireAccount(context);
+  if (account instanceof Response) return account;
+  try {
+    const response = await accountFetch('credentials', {}, account.token);
+    if (!response.ok) return upstreamError(response, context);
+    const data = await response.json();
+    if (!isPasskeyList(data)) return json({ error: 'The passkey service returned an invalid credential list.' }, 502);
+    // Never expose public keys, tokens, or other upstream authentication data.
+    return json({ rpId: data.rpId, userId: data.userId, credentials: data.credentials.map(({ id, name, aaguid, registeredAt, lastUsedAt }) => ({ id, name, aaguid, registeredAt, lastUsedAt })) });
+  } catch {
+    return json({ error: 'Unable to load your passkeys. Please try again.' }, 502);
+  }
+};

+import { test } from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { isBase64Url, isPasskeyList, syncPasskeys } from '../src/lib/passkeys.ts';
+import { GET } from '../src/pages/api/account/passkeys/index.ts';
+import { PUT, DELETE } from '../src/pages/api/account/passkeys/[id].ts';
+import { POST as login } from '../src/pages/api/account/login.ts';
+
+const list = { rpId: 'example.com', userId: 'dXNlcg', credentials: [{ id: 'Y3JlZA', name: 'Laptop', registeredAt: 1700000000000 }] };
+function context(method = 'GET', body, account = { token: 'secret', username: 'reader' }, origin = 'https://example.com') {
+  return {
+    request: new Request('https://example.com/devtools-times/api/account/passkeys/Y3JlZA', { method, ...(method === 'GET' ? {} : { headers: { Origin: origin }, body: body && JSON.stringify(body) }) }),
+    params: { id: 'Y3JlZA' },
+    session: { get: async () => account, delete: async () => {} },
+  };
+}
+
+test('Base64URL and complete-list validation protects synchronization', () => {
+  for (const invalid of ['', 'a', 'has padding=', 'colon:id', undefined]) assert.equal(isBase64Url(invalid), false);
+  assert.equal(isBase64Url('Y3JlZA'), true);
+  assert.equal(isPasskeyList(list), true);
+  assert.equal(isPasskeyList({ ...list, credentials: [] }), true);
+  assert.equal(isPasskeyList({ ...list, userId: 'a' }), false);
+  assert.equal(isPasskeyList({ ...list, credentials: [{ ...list.credentials[0], aaguid: 123 }] }), false);
+  assert.equal(isPasskeyList({ ...list, credentials: [{ ...list.credentials[0], id: 'bad:id' }] }), false);
+  assert.equal(isPasskeyList({ ...list, credentials: [{ ...list.credentials[0], registeredAt: 'yesterday' }] }), false);
+});
+
+test('sync uses server RP and IDs, including removal of the final key', async () => {
+  const calls = [];
+  const api = { signalAllAcceptedCredentials: async value => calls.push(value) };
+  assert.equal(await syncPasskeys(list, api), 'synced');
+  assert.deepEqual(calls[0], { rpId: 'example.com', userId: 'dXNlcg', allAcceptedCredentialIds: ['Y3JlZA'] });
+  await syncPasskeys({ ...list, credentials: [] }, api);
+  assert.deepEqual(calls[1].allAcceptedCredentialIds, []);
+  assert.equal(await syncPasskeys(list), 'unsupported');
+});
+
+test('sync failures are nonfatal and malformed lists are never signaled', async () => {
+  const warn = console.warn;
+  console.warn = () => {};
+  try {
+    let calls = 0;
+    const api = { signalAllAcceptedCredentials: async () => { calls++; throw Error('denied'); } };
+    assert.equal(await syncPasskeys({ ...list, userId: 'a' }, api), 'failed');
+    assert.equal(calls, 0);
+    assert.equal(await syncPasskeys(list, api), 'failed');
+  } finally { console.warn = warn; }
+});
+
+test('account endpoints require authentication and same-origin writes', async () => {
+  assert.equal((await GET(context('GET', undefined, null))).status, 401);
+  assert.equal((await DELETE(context('DELETE', undefined, undefined, 'https://attacker.example'))).status, 403);
+  assert.equal((await PUT(context('PUT', { name: '  ' }))).status, 400);
+  assert.equal((await PUT(context('PUT', { name: 'x'.repeat(81) }))).status, 400);
+});
+
+test('proxy filters sensitive fields, enforces ownership, and persists through upstream', async () => {
+  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
+  const calls = [];
+  globalThis.fetch = async (url, init) => {
+    calls.push({ url: String(url), init });
+    return Response.json({ ...list, token: 'never expose', credentials: [{ ...list.credentials[0], publicKey: 'private metadata' }] });
+  };
+  try {
+    const response = await GET(context());
+    assert.equal(response.headers.get('Cache-Control'), 'no-store');
+    assert.deepEqual(await response.json(), list);
+    assert.equal(calls[0].init.headers.Authorization, 'Bearer secret');
+    const foreign = context('DELETE'); foreign.params.id = 'b3RoZXI';
+    assert.equal((await DELETE(foreign)).status, 404);
+    assert.equal(calls.length, 2);
+    assert.equal((await PUT(context('PUT', { name: '  Work laptop  ' }))).status, 200);
+    assert.equal(calls.at(-1).init.body, JSON.stringify({ name: 'Work laptop' }));
+    assert.equal((await DELETE(context('DELETE'))).status, 200);
+    assert.equal(calls.at(-1).init.method, 'DELETE');
+  } finally { globalThis.fetch = originalFetch; }
+});
+
+test('upstream expiration clears account; invalid responses fail closed', async () => {
+  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
+  try {
+    globalThis.fetch = async () => new Response('', { status: 401 });
+    const ctx = context(); let cleared = false;
+    ctx.session.delete = async () => { cleared = true; };
+    assert.equal((await GET(ctx)).status, 401); assert.equal(cleared, true);
+    globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ credentials: [] });
+    assert.equal((await GET(context())).status, 502);
+  } finally { globalThis.fetch = originalFetch; }
+});
+
+test('sign-in retains token only in regenerated server session', async () => {
+  const originalFetch = globalThis.fetch;
+  const steps = [];
+  globalThis.fetch = async () => Response.json({ token: 'upstream-token' });
+  try {
+    const ctx = context('POST', { username: 'reader', password: 'password' });
+    ctx.session.regenerate = async () => { steps.push('regenerate'); };
+    ctx.session.set = async (key, value) => { steps.push([key, value]); };
+    const response = await login(ctx);
+    assert.deepEqual(await response.json(), { success: true });
+    assert.deepEqual(steps, ['regenerate', ['account', { username: 'reader', token: 'upstream-token' }]]);
+  } finally { globalThis.fetch = originalFetch; }
+});

+# Homepage authentication integration
+
+The homepage supports browser autofill while browsing, a feature-detected immediate
+chooser for Rewards, My Account, Order Now, and Sign in, and an inline password or
+explicit passkey fallback. Cancelling leaves the customer on the homepage. Successful
+verification resumes the selected destination; signing in from the form alone stays
+on the homepage.
+
+This repository serves static files only. Implement these same-origin endpoints
+before sign-in can authenticate real customers. All responses must be JSON, uncached,
+and must not redirect to a login page:
+
+| Endpoint | Contract |
+| --- | --- |
+| `GET /api/login/session` | `{ "authenticated": true }` for an existing valid session, otherwise false or 401. |
+| `POST /api/login/options` | Accept `{}`. Return WebAuthn request options with a fresh base64url `challenge`, explicit configured `rpId`, `userVerification: "preferred"`, and omitted or empty `allowCredentials`. |
+| `POST /api/login/verify` | Accept the assertion from `PublicKeyCredential.toJSON()`. Verify it, establish a session, and return `{ "authenticated": true }`. Use 404 only for an unknown credential. |
+| `POST /api/login/password` | Accept `{ "username": "…", "password": "…" }`. Verify credentials, establish a session, and return `{ "authenticated": true }`; reject invalid credentials with a non-2xx status. |
+
+Use HTTPS in production. Generate and store challenges on the server, bind them to
+the visitor's session, expire them, and consume them once on verification. The client
+preloads options to preserve click activation and considers them fresh for 60 seconds;
+the server's challenge lifetime must accommodate that interval. Do not rotate the
+challenge for unrelated session checks. Verify origin, configured RP ID, challenge,
+signature, and the stored user-verification policy using a maintained WebAuthn server
+library. Store only salted password hashes and rate-limit authentication attempts.
+Set an HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite session cookie after successful verification and
+validate same-origin requests to prevent login CSRF. Destination routes must enforce
+authentication on the server; client state is only a UI convenience.
+
+The frontend never stores credentials or an authenticated flag in browser storage.
+Errors, unsupported browsers, and unavailable endpoints leave the inline form usable.
+`/logout` retains the existing site's logout route.
+
+Run `npm ci` and `npm run build` after dependency changes to rebuild the self-hosted
+WebAuthn compatibility bundle in `assets/webauthn-polyfills.js`. No server is required
+for that build. Deploy the bundle alongside `index.html`.
